'''Mirosław Handke''' (19 March 1946 – 22 April 2021) was a Polish chemist and politician, who served as [[Ministry of National Education (Poland)|Minister of Education]] from 1997 to 2000.

== Early life ==
Mirosław Handke was born on 19 March 1946 in [[Leszno]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|date=22 April 2021|title=Zmarł Mirosław Handke – Minister Edukacji Narodowej w latach 1997-2000|url=https://www.gov.pl/web/edukacja-i-nauka/zmarl-miroslaw-handke--minister-edukacji-narodowej-w-latach-1997-2000|url-status=live|access-date=22 April 2021|website=gov.pl|language=pl|archive-date=22 April 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210422143334/https://www.gov.pl/web/edukacja-i-nauka/zmarl-miroslaw-handke--minister-edukacji-narodowej-w-latach-1997-2000}}</ref>

Handke attended [[Jagiellonian University]].<ref name=":0" />

== Career ==
Handke was the Minister of National Education from 1997 to 2000.<ref name=":0" />

Handke was the architect of the 1999 education reform.<ref name=":0" />
